one_liner_zh: CrowdStrike最新季度營收與每股盈餘雙雙優於市場預期，年增率達25.83%。
one_liner_en: CrowdStrike reported quarterly revenue and EPS beating expectations, with revenue growing 25.83% YoY.
beat_or_miss: 超預期，EPS與營收均擊敗分析師共識預估
highlights_zh: EPS實際達0.31美元，優於預期的0.29美元
核心資安訂閱業務需求保持強勁
營運效率提升帶動獲利能力改善
highlights_en: Revenue reached $1.47B, representing a 25.83% YoY increase
Core cybersecurity subscription demand remained robust
Improved operating efficiency drove better profitability
risks_zh: 本益比處於極高水準，估值壓力沉重
宏觀經濟不確定性可能影響企業資安IT支出預算
risks_en: Extremely high trailing P/E ratio presents severe valuation pressure
Macroeconomic uncertainty could impact enterprise cybersecurity IT budgets
ai_view_zh: 觀點：財報表現穩健展現強大成長動能，然高達5000以上的本益比意味著市場已給予極高期待，短中期股價可能受高估值限制而震盪。持續追蹤指標為 ARR（年度經常性收入）成長率與大型企業客戶留存率。
ai_view_en: View: Solid financial results demonstrate strong growth momentum, but a trailing P/E above 5000 implies towering market expectations, which may cause near-to-mid-term stock volatility due to valuation constraints. Key metrics to track are ARR growth rate and enterprise customer retention.
